title: FileNode/set: onExists and sibling-name uniqueness on update and across one /set
description: Found in spec-sync batch 2 (filenode-20), predates it. -20 §3.2.3 applies onExists to a 'create or update' and says the server MUST check sibling-name uniqueness against the result of all creates, updates and destroys of one FileNode/set together; §3.1.1 says siblings MUST NOT share a name. crate-jmap-filenode-server checks collisions and applies onExists only on create: an update that renames or moves a node onto an existing sibling's name succeeds and leaves duplicate names, and destroy-plus-create of the same name in one /set fails. Needs update-path collision detection (alreadyExists for a discoverable sibling, forbidden for an undiscoverable one, replace/rename handling) and whole-/set evaluation.
